plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai instructions replayed a stale positional CSS selector targeting the second navigation item, which now corresponds to 'Solutions' rather than 'Developers', leading the execution to the wrong page and failing the URL assertion.
observedIndicators: The cached runSource used primary selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button', which matched the 'Solutions' button instead of 'Developers'.
Tool execution history confirms clicking on '<button class=\"nav-item\" ...>Solutions</button>'.
The flow subsequently navigated to 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of the expected 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/'.
The failure screenshot shows 'Developers' remains available in the header menu, confirming the page still supports the test objective.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry automation
remediationSteps.details: Invalidate the deterministic page.ai cache for checkly.test.ts and re-run automation so the planner re-identifies the Developers dropdown locator.

plan.notes: Clearing the page.ai cache and allowing autonomous re-planning will correctly select the 'Developers' dropdown and its 'Documentation' item.
